parsed.main_gap: Step 2 uses the false assertion that a non-increasing positive integer starting above 1 cannot reach 1; survival of a nonunit needs a separate argument.

errors.description: A decreasing positive integer can reach 1. The gap is easily repaired: a legal move cannot produce two 1s, since if gcd(m,n)=1 then the other output is mn>1, while if gcd(m,n)>1 the gcd output itself exceeds 1.
errors.quote: A positive integer that never increases and starts above $1$ can never reach $1$; hence $P > 1$ after any number of moves.

parsed.notes: Apart from this localized flaw, termination and the prime-wise valuation-gcd invariant are correctly proved, and they establish the choice-independent formula for M.
